purpose: Research-validation layer for consent, inference, assumption, interpretation, and tool-routing fidelity.
validation_requirements: falsify any interpretation that adds an unstated premise, motive, future plan, hidden request, or consent
verify explicit authorization envelope is identified before action
verify capability, access, prior permission, or tool availability are never treated as authorization
verify tool action class is equal to or narrower than authorized action class
verify artifact type is not substituted without explicit authorization
verify optional assumptions are not operationalized
verify material ambiguity is retrieved or clarified rather than guessed
verify nonmaterial ambiguity uses narrowest reversible interpretation within scope
verify binding corrections invalidate conflicting interpretation and downstream actions
verify execution result is compared to literal request, settled constraints, and canonical state
verify execution stops when authorized objective is satisfied
verify new versions or artifacts are not created when the user requested cleanup of the existing canonical artifact
